name: Deep Plane Facelift Specialist (Dr Fulvio Correa)
_editorial: Original practice video. On-page text is a summary, not a word-for-word transcript. Timed captions drop credential and marketing claims that the audio may still say.

summary.en: Dr. Fulvio Correa, a member of the Colombian Society of Plastic Surgery (SCCP), explains facelift surgery in Cartagena, Colombia. The video describes moving the SMAS layer as well as the skin, and adding volume where the face has lost it. It also shows how the team helps travelers with questions, the trip and the recovery house. The plan is confirmed in consultation.
